title: Close-up of an Arabidopsis thaliana growing in a Growth chamber study (time-lapse video)
author: TimeScience
description_credit: Close up of an Arabidopsis thaliana plant growing in a growth chamber study. Plants were filmed for 11 days under standard fluorescent lighting conditions. An incandescent light was used at night to provide light for the camera. Timelapse captured with an 18MP DSLR and a pclix intervelometer. Movie rendered with TimeScience TimePlayer software. Thanks to Jasper Pengelly for growing the plants.

title: Growing of corn
author: Szabolcs Turuczki
description_credit: In this accelerated video we can see how corn seeds start to grow strongly and then stops it, starting to strengthen its roots instead of, as a result of getting good quality of soil, enough light and warm. Making the video cooperated: Peter Mikics and Anna Benczur.

title: Growing of wheat
author: Szabolcs Turuczki
description_credit: In this accelerated video the creation of the root-system of the wheat can be seen. At first the strong main root, and then the other parts of the root grow – after this the root hairs appear, too. Their task is picking up minerals from the ground while the root holds the whole plant. Growing upwards starts only after being stable for sure. During making the video cooperated: Peter Mikics and Anna Benczur.
